decision_basis: Task instruction, immutable upstream code, approved prospective numerical choices, authenticated structural metadata and anatomical-template-only geometry receipts. No original BOLD voxel values, connectivity or age endpoints were inspected before this freeze.
execution_authority: This frozen public contract does not itself authorize execution; a separate bounded pilot/full gate remains required.
retained_key_names: Historical keys ending in _proposal are retained for interface compatibility; every value in this frozen version is an adopted rule, not an unresolved choice.

claim_scope.estimand: Signed movie-derived connectivity of two fixed sphere networks, and descriptive sensitivity of cross-sectional child age rank associations to added global-signal regression and FD rank adjustment.
claim_scope.adaptation: Richardson-derived public-data sensitivity application, not a reproduction of the paper's primary-motor/artifact-adjusted preprocessing.
not_established: GSR identifies or removes an artifact
refutation or replication of the paper

authority.source: Independently authenticate the final closed original/template/provenance inventory before reconstruction.
authority.canonical_geometry_and_cleaning: Original bytes and declared software arithmetic determine supports, GS, nuisance designs, numerical ranks, canonical residual activity and canonical clean series. Never recompute these from rounded output receipts.
authority.accepted_numeric_primitive: The source-close accepted cleaned ROI series are the sole downstream numerical authority.
authority.replay: Accepted clean series -> signed ROI Pearson -> clipped Fisher edge-family means -> participant metrics -> own child ranks and adult means, once and without intermediate receipt rounding.
authority.no_second_endpoint_gate: Do not compare accepted-series-derived correlations, group means, rank ties, p-values or statuses to a hidden source endpoint or historical answer bank.
authority.shared_numerics: The SHA-bound public reporting/rank kernel is copied byte-identically into the private verifier, which uses only its authenticated private copy. Source authentication and original extraction are independently implemented; the header/table primitives, NumPy/SciPy/sklearn libraries and declared conditioning/rank semantics are shared and disclosed.

source.source_manifest_status: Closed original/template/provenance inventory authenticated as opaque bytes before structural parsing; no BOLD signal analysis used for admission.
source.subject_ids_rule: Exactly sub-pixar001 through sub-pixar155 inclusive; literal strings, no digit stripping, aliases or leading-zero normalization.
source.canonical_order: Ascending literal subject_id; submitted keyed rows/axes may be coherently permuted.
source.phenotype_status: Authenticated participant table and fixed released index contain exactly 155 literal participants, 122 child and 33 adult. The pinned description's older 50-child summary is not cohort authority.

headers_and_scaling.authority: Read each original file's header separately and retain its documentary and effective scaling fields in run_metadata.source_observed.persons keyed by subject_id. Do not infer equality of scaling from shared geometry.
headers_and_scaling.scaling: Convert stored values to float64, multiply by that participant file's effective slope, then add that file's effective intercept. Preserve raw scl_slope/scl_inter as well as the effective pair; there is no cohort-common scaling pair.

spatial_unit_policy.bold_convention_authority: Pinned Nilearn 0.12.1 development_fmri description and func.py state 4 mm; the original processing README documents MNI152NLin2009cAsym normalization and the 4-unit downsampling matrix.
spatial_unit_policy.template_convention_authority: Pinned struct.py identifies the exact Git-bound packaged asset as the 1-mm MNI template. Its raw header unit remains unknown.
spatial_unit_policy.interpretation_limit: These release documents define operational millimeter coordinates; neither individual registration nor identity of the anatomical-template edition and derivative normalization is independently established.

source.spatial_units_status: The authenticated BOLD and template header unit fields are unknown. Use the explicitly approved release-documented millimeter convention without rewriting or rescaling the selected affines.
source.clock: All 168 released frames per subject remain in original row order. Raw fourth zoom is 1 with unknown temporal units, not a verified one-second TR. Pinned func.py documents 2 seconds TR; this is provenance, not recovered header timing. No temporal filter, measured movie-onset or slice-reference alignment is asserted.
source.required_geometry: All twelve ROI supports and the GS support must be nonempty for every participant. No moving centers, dropping subjects or replacing the mask.
source.finite_policy_proposal: Require finite scaled BOLD at every contributing voxel in the union of the twelve sphere supports and GS support, for every frame. Do not require finite unused voxels. Fail rather than silently zero-impute contributing nonfinite signal.
source.finite_policy_status: Parent-approved pre-result explicit departure from wrapper ensure_finite side effects.
source.selection: No age, motion, diagnosis, frame, ROI or effect-based exclusions; group labels come only from the original participants table.

software_reference.dependency_status: Parent-approved pre-result reference software; agent implementations are evaluated by source fidelity/semantics, not a version-string fingerprint.
software_reference.reference_precision: Float64 source scaling, ROI/GS signal arithmetic, nuisance arrays and temporal cleaning, with C-contiguous time-by-feature matrices. The template loader's explicit float32 normalization is retained separately.
software_reference.precision_disclosure: Float64 signal arithmetic and the added inactivity rule are prospective numerical clarifications, not a promise of bitwise identity to all legacy dtype/layout paths.
software_reference.equivalence: Independent implementations may pass declared source fidelity and exact support decisions; no library-version prose fingerprint is graded.

roi_geometry.support_operator: Preserve the reached 0.12.1 apply_mask_and_get_affinity rule on the full BOLD grid, without an added mask: radius_neighbors_graph at radius 9, plus its rounded inverse-affine nearest voxel when in grid, plus its first integer-world-coordinate matching voxel when present. These additions are not replaced by pure-radius geometry.
roi_geometry.coordinate_enumeration: np.ndindex(shape[:3]) C-index order; world coordinates from the selected NIfTI affine. Preserve pinned NumPy/sklearn radius and rounding behavior, including ties.
roi_geometry.raw_mean: For each frame and ROI, float64 np.mean of the contiguous 1-D vector of scaled contributing voxels in ascending C-flat index order.
roi_geometry.support_receipt: Source-bound voxel count and grid-inclusive digest for each subject/ROI, plus a separate GS support record; overlap is allowed and not a defect.
roi_geometry.registration_limit: Using stated world coordinates is an operational template-space convention, not an independent verification of individual anatomical registration.

global_signal.template_identity_status: Exact immutable Git-blob identity and captured-byte SHA256 authenticated. Geometry-only comparison decoded this anatomical template, never BOLD values; no binary mask or other template substitution.
global_signal.template_load: load_mni152_template(resolution=1): convert template values to float32, divide by their global maximum, preserve source grid/affine.
global_signal.resample: Preserve 0.12.1 resample_to_img(template, BOLD, copy_header=True, force_resample=False): continuous cubic interpolation, order F, clip=False, fill_value=0. Equal shapes plus np.allclose(target_affine,source_affine) use the upstream no-op branch. Otherwise preserve the exact-affine identity shortcut, scipy.linalg.inv(source_affine) @ target_affine, exact-diagonal dispatch and reached integer-translation crop/padding optimization.
global_signal.mask: Threshold resampled normalized template >= 0.5; binary erosion two iterations, largest connected component when nonempty, binary dilation four iterations, binary erosion two iterations.
global_signal.signal: Extract all mask voxels in ascending C-flat order into a C-contiguous float64 matrix; apply the specified 0.12.1 linear detrend to each voxel, no standardization, then mean each frame across the resulting contiguous voxel row in float64.
not_equivalent_receipts: average first then detrend as an undeclared floating-point substitution
global_signal.appended_regressor: Append this derived GS as nuisance column 16 in with_GSR. It is detrended again with the other confounds by the specified temporal cleaning.

confounds.missingness_conflict: All fifteen selected original columns are finite at all 168 frames for every subject. No values are imputed. The retained first-row policy interface admits no missing token in this frozen source; old fillna(0) does not broaden it. Finite first-row FD, including zero, is observed data.
confounds.mean_fd: Accurate float64 math.fsum of observed original finite FD entries divided by observed count, before zero fill; require count > 0. Preserve missing indices/count and sum. This is source-canonical covariate authority; submitted mean_fd is a receipt only.
confounds.unselected_columns: Preserve original header/order and identify excluded columns; do not consume them or silently treat reduced-cache files as originals.

temporal_cleaning.detrend_operator: Copy C-float64 input; subtract np.mean(axis=0); build float64 arange(T), subtract its mean, divide by sqrt(sum(regressor**2)) unless below eps64; subtract np.dot(regressor[:,0], signals[:,batch]) * regressor. Use one batch below 500 features, otherwise 10 gen_even_slices as 0.12.1.
temporal_cleaning.nuisance_operator: Detrend nuisance; subtract its column means again; divide by population np.std(axis=0), replacing only SD < eps64 with 1. scipy.linalg.qr(mode='economic', pivoting=True), retain columns with abs(diag(R)) > 100*eps64. Record retained count and pivots as source diagnostics.
temporal_cleaning.projection: residual = detrended_ROI - (Q @ Q.T) @ detrended_ROI, with the first matrix product performed explicitly; do not reassociate to Q @ (Q.T @ Y).
temporal_cleaning.final_standardization: Preserve 0.12.1: residual minus np.mean(axis=0), sample np.std(axis=0, ddof=1), replace SD < eps64 by 1, then divide. Apply canonical inactive zero sentinels as declared below. No stable-SD substitution for the standardization operator.
temporal_cleaning.rank_note: QR support is the named computational convention, not a full-rank requirement or a promise of universal mathematical-rank agreement across BLAS/layouts.

stable_arithmetic.constant: If every finite entry equals the first entry exactly, centered vector is exactly zero.
stable_arithmetic.center: Otherwise s=max(abs(x)); form z=x/s; subtract math.fsum(z)/n. This dimensionless centered representation and its scale s define C(x).
stable_arithmetic.norm: Use a second max-absolute scaling on the centered representation, then sqrt(math.fsum(square(normalized entries))); restore scales only when representable. Compare ratios/thresholds in scaled form to avoid spurious underflow/overflow.
stable_arithmetic.pearson: Dot normalized stable centered directions with math.fsum. A finite excursion outside [-1,1] no larger than 1e-12 is clipped to the nearest boundary; larger excursions or nonfinite arithmetic are unavailable, never hidden epsilon denominators.
stable_arithmetic.means: Use math.fsum(values)/len(values) for Fisher edge means and adult participant means. No intermediate CSV/JSON rounding.

activity.status: Parent-approved prospective residual/raw and continuous-child conditioning rules before original signals.
activity.reference_arm_roi: Canonical source residual active iff geometry is present, ||C(raw_ROI)|| > 0, and ||C(prestandardization_residual)|| > 1e-12 * ||C(raw_ROI)||, strictly, using stable scaled comparisons.
activity.sentinel: Canonical inactive cleaned columns are zero. Accepted inactive finite entries may differ within pointwise tolerance but are ignored and cannot reactivate an ROI.
activity.metric_support: A metric requires all fixed endpoint ROIs active in its arm. Keep all fixed edges and report null for the metric if any required endpoint is inactive. No available-edge averaging.
activity.meaning: This is numerical resolution, not an effect-size/QC threshold. It adds a declared guard to the named cleaning operator.
activity.continuous_child_support_proposal: For each metric with all child participant slots defined, canonical continuous participant values exactly constant under stable centering imply null child associations. When active, require accepted-vs-canonical continuous child centered relative-L2 error <= 1e-6. Adult means have no cohort-variation requirement.
activity.rank_support_boundary: Do not require canonical outcome ranks, rank residual support, Spearman r/p or verdict equality. Accepted rank ties/residuals determine their own definedness under the declared rank rule.

participant_connectivity.operator: tanh(math.fsum(atanh(clip(Pearson(edge), -0.999999, 0.999999)) for each fixed edge) / n_edges)
participant_connectivity.undefined: Null participant metric with explicit status; no omitted participant, edge or row.

child_inference.population: Original Child_Adult == child; no new age cutoff or FD exclusion.
child_inference.ranks: scipy.stats.rankdata(method='average') in float64 on complete accepted unrounded participant metrics, canonical ages, and canonical mean FD; exact binary64 ties, no tie epsilon.
child_inference.ordinary: Stable Pearson of age and accepted metric ranks; df=n-2.
child_inference.motion_adjusted_proposal: D=[ones, rank(canonical_mean_fd)] in C-float64. Canonical scipy.linalg.svd(D, full_matrices=False, lapack_driver='gesvd'); keep singular values > max(D.shape)*eps64*smax. q is retained rank. Apply R(v)=C(v)-Ukeep@(Ukeep.T@C(v)) to age and accepted metric ranks, with physical-scale centering represented stably. Stable Pearson of residuals; df=n-q-1.
child_inference.motion_design_status: Parent-approved pre-result actual-rank replacement for old unqualified lstsq/default cutoff and hardcoded n-3.
child_inference.rank_activity: Input centered rank norm must be positive; centered projected residual norm must be strictly > 1e-12 * input centered rank norm. Apply to canonical age and own accepted metric ranks; no source metric-rank gate.
child_inference.p_value: Conventional two-sided Student-t approximation: for |r|<1 and df>0, t=r*sqrt(df/(1-r*r)); p=2*scipy.stats.t.sf(abs(t),df). This is not an exact permutation test or a causal/population guarantee.
child_inference.perfect: Supported |r|=1 and df>0 gives r retained and p=0, status perfect_correlation. No infinite t receipt is required.
child_inference.complete_case_policy: All 122 slots retained; if any participant metric is undefined, both child association outputs are null with incomplete_subject_support and n_defined recorded. Do not drop participants.
child_inference.group_support_note: Source-continuous support is a disclosed conditioning guard only; accepted rank changes near ties are allowed and may change r, p or own rank-null status.

adult_descriptives.operator: math.fsum(accepted-series-derived participant metric)/33, separately for each metric.
adult_descriptives.complete: All 33 defined -> finite arithmetic mean, including constant or zero means. Otherwise null with n_defined and incomplete_subject_support. No available-case mean or second Fisher transformation.

comparison_proposal.status: Frozen parent-approved pre-BOLD tolerances, qualified on manufactured cases and not selected from original connectivity or endpoint gaps.
comparison_proposal.independent_domains: Correlations and adult metric means in [-1,1], p in [0,1], counts/ranks exact non-Boolean integers; enforce domains before numerical tolerance.

pre_signal_evidence.resolved_structural_flags: Only unknown spatial units and unresolved header clock were flagged; the release-documented operational conventions above resolve their interpretation without modifying headers.
pre_signal_evidence.scope: Descriptive source/geometry qualification only; not evidence for connectivity, age effects, scientific validity or model difficulty.
